cores -n 1 --title 'PR883 C4 pinned object adapter strict support compile only' --link https://github.com/buster14a/buster/pull/883 -- /bin/sh -c '
set -C
task_probe_source=work/pr883-performance/hot-placement-v4/object-probe-source-v1
task_probe_build=work/pr883-performance/hot-placement-v4/object-probe-build-v1
/usr/bin/sha256sum "$task_probe_source/object_probe.c" "$task_probe_source/hp_common.c" "$task_probe_source/hp_common.h" "$task_probe_source/hp_elf.c" "$task_probe_source/hp_elf.h" > "$task_probe_build/sources-before.sha256"
task_before_status=$?
task_compile_status=1
if [ "$task_before_status" -eq 0 ] && printf "%s  %s\n" a6cb069f4a50932f9b9b1b791413ca07bf5a8757a9af2d75fde8559063e5dcb0 "$task_probe_source/hp_elf.c" | /usr/bin/sha256sum --check --status
then
    /usr/bin/clang --no-default-config -std=c17 -O2 -Wall -Wextra -Werror -pedantic "$task_probe_source/hp_common.c" "$task_probe_source/hp_elf.c" "$task_probe_source/object_probe.c" -o "$task_probe_build/object-probe-strict"
    task_compile_status=$?
fi
/usr/bin/sha256sum "$task_probe_source/object_probe.c" "$task_probe_source/hp_common.c" "$task_probe_source/hp_common.h" "$task_probe_source/hp_elf.c" "$task_probe_source/hp_elf.h" > "$task_probe_build/sources-after.sha256"
task_after_status=$?
cmp -s "$task_probe_build/sources-before.sha256" "$task_probe_build/sources-after.sha256"
task_same_status=$?
task_final_status=1
if [ "$task_before_status" -eq 0 ] && [ "$task_compile_status" -eq 0 ] && [ "$task_after_status" -eq 0 ] && [ "$task_same_status" -eq 0 ]
then
    task_final_status=0
fi
printf "%s\n" "$task_final_status" > "$task_probe_build/strict-build.exit"
exit "$task_final_status"
' > work/pr883-performance/hot-placement-v4/object-probe-build-v1/strict-build.log 2>&1
